eras.label: current
eras.source: Maryland General Assembly (Legislative Redistricting Advisory Commission plan)
eras.note: Maryland's 47 legislative districts mostly elect 3 Delegates each from the same boundary (some split into sub-districts), so there are 71 unique House boundary shapes for 141 seats. A separate legislative-map challenge (In re 2022 Legislative Districting) was rejected by Maryland's high court in April 2022 — no boundaries changed.
